description: Read recent MartinLoop events, ledger entries, and operator control receipts for a single run. Use to observe live or completed run activity, diagnose stuck or failed runs, or audit operator actions. Do not use to check run completion status — use martin_get_status instead. Do not use to retrieve verification evidence — use martin_get_verification_results instead. This tool only reads persisted run files and does not execute commands, modify state, or contact GitHub.

file.description: Absolute or relative path to a loop-record.json file or run directory. Mutually exclusive with loopId and latest.

latest.description: When true, loads the most recently updated run in the run store. Mutually exclusive with file and loopId.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return, sorted by timestamp descending. Defaults to 20.

loopId.description: MartinLoop run identifier from the run store. Mutually exclusive with file and latest.

runsDir.description: Override the default run-store root directory. Optional; defaults to the MartinLoop runs directory.

name: martin_logs

entries.description: Log entries sorted by timestamp descending, capped at limit.

kind.description: Event type or control action name.

source.description: Origin stream: loop event bus, governance ledger, or operator control receipts.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the event, if present.

approvalState.description: Whether the run is waiting at a human-approval checkpoint.

lifecycleState.description: Current run lifecycle state (e.g. running, completed, cancelled).

pauseState.description: Whether the run is active, paused, or has a pending cancellation.

logCount.description: Number of log entries returned after applying the limit.

source.description: Resolved path to the loop-record source file.

sourceKind.description: How the run was identified: by file path, loop ID, latest flag, or runs directory.
